source_anchors.operation: getDriftTime @note: the drift time of an IM spectrum is always set on the spectrum, while the Precursor drift time is often unpopulated; IMTypes::DRIFTTIME_NOT_SET (-1) means unset
Chunk{start inclusive, end exclusive, is_sorted}; Chunks::add starts at the previous end and ends at the spectrum's current size, holding a const MSSpectrum& across mutation
containsIMData inspects only float-array names: a child of 'MS:1002893 ! ion mobility array'

rasterizeIMFrame notes: requires IM data, does NOT require m/z sorting, zero-initializes the output; throws MissingInformation/NullPointer/InvalidValue/InvalidRange; the @code block is Python for pyOpenMS
sortByIonMobility: getIMData may throw, the IM array is captured by reference, std::is_sorted short-circuits, and sort() indexes the captured array per peak (an empty IM array reads out of bounds)

sortByPositionPresorted: empty chunks return; one sorted chunk returns; with no data arrays the whole peak list is stable_sorted and chunks are ignored; otherwise per-chunk stable_sort followed by a balanced recursive std::inplace_merge over chunks[first].start/chunks[mid].end/chunks[last].end and selectUnchecked
isSortedByIM: getIMData may throw, then std::is_sorted over the IM array with '<'
updateRanges: mobility comes from the IM float array when containsIMData(), otherwise from getDriftTime() when it is not -1
getDriftTimeUnitAsString indexes NamesOfDriftTimeUnit without a bounds check
getIonMobilityArray__ scans the float arrays in storage order and returns the first whose name IMDataArrayUtils::getIMUnit recognizes
maybeGetIMData returns {DriftTimeUnit::NONE, {}} when no IM array exists, which collides with an empty IM array and with a CV term that declares no unit

rasterizeIMFrame: bounds validated, total_pixels = im_bins * mz_bins multiplied unchecked, buffer zeroed, empty spectrum returns early, IM/peak length mismatch throws after the buffer was already cleared, peaks outside [min,max] skipped, bin = (value - min) * scale truncated then clamped to bins-1, row-major mz_bin * im_bins + im_bin

getIMUnit: exact PSI-MS name lookup and MS:1002893 ancestry first, unit from has_units (MS:1002814 -> VSSC, UO:0000028 -> MILLISECOND, UO:0000324 -> CCS, else NONE with a warning); then the MEAN_INVERSE_REDUCED_ION_MOBILITY_ARRAY / INVERSE_REDUCED_ION_MOBILITY prefixes as VSSC; then the ION_MOBILITY prefix, VSSC for an embedded MS:1002815 or MS:1003006, CCS for MS:1002954, MILLISECOND otherwise
NamesOfDriftTimeUnit = {"<NONE>", "ms", "1/K0", "FAIMS_CV", "CCS"}

IMDataConverter::setIMUnit forwards to IMDataArrayUtils::setIMUnit, which names a MILLISECOND array 'mean ion mobility array' (MS:1002816); this is how the class test's getPrefilledSpec marks its second float array

getPrefilledSpec: ten peaks in descending m/z 423.269..412.321, intensities and three identical float arrays [56,201,31,31,31,37,29,34,60,29], float array 1 renamed to the millisecond IM CV term, two string arrays, two integer arrays, RT 5
Drift-time sections: default -1, set 0.451, default unit NONE printing "<NONE>", MILLISECOND printing "ms"
updateRanges over getPrefilledSpec: intensity 29..201, m/z 412.321..423.269, mobility 29..201 from the IM array; a single peak leaves RangeMobility empty
sortByIonMobility: isSortedByIM false before and true after, getIMData index 1 and unit MILLISECOND

sortByPositionPresorted: ten peaks appended in five descending-start runs giving chunks [0,3) [3,6) [6,8) [8,9) [9,10), all is_sorted, producing intensities 12,12,13,14,15,16,18,19,20,23 with array names f1/f2/f3, s1/s2, i1 intact
getIMData over getPrefilledSpec: index 1, unit MILLISECOND
maybeGetIMData: an 'Ion Mobility' array [1,2,3] yields MILLISECOND; no arrays, an empty array list and the name 'Wrong Name' all yield {NONE, {}}

evidence: Tier 3 (source review) for every expectation carrying a section number: the literals of all 71 START_SECTIONs of MSSpectrum_test.cpp transcribed into tests/spectrum_mobility.rs, including the ion-mobility permutation of getPrefilledSpec and the five-chunk presorted fixture. Tier 4 (independently derived) for rasterizeIMFrame, which has no upstream section: bin indices, aggregation and the max-bound clamp computed from MSSpectrum.cpp:857-967, and for the native boundaries (chunk tiling, dishonest is_sorted claims, empty and mis-sized IM arrays, non-finite values, pixel and item ceilings). The nine PSI-MS ion-mobility array names and their units were read out of resources/cv/psi-ms.obo, which is the CV the source resolves at run time. No C++ was built or executed.
